paper.paper_scope: Investigates the influence of Al content (2 vs 8 wt.%) and precipitation state (short 450 °C/1 h vs long annealing) on the strain hardening mechanisms and deformation structures of two austenitic high-Mn low-density Fe–Mn–Al–C steels (2Al and 8Al), characterized by ECCI and TEM.
paper.title: Influence of Al content and precipitation state on the mechanical behavior of austenitic high-Mn low-density steels

unmapped_findings: Fabrication of both alloys: melted in an induction furnace under Ar atmosphere, cast to round bars 25 mm in diameter, reheated to 1200 °C for 30 min, hot-rolled to 75% thickness reduction at 1100 °C and water quenched (block b0010).
All tensile samples were solution-treated for 2 h at 1100 °C under Ar and finally quenched in water before subsequent annealing between 450 and 650 °C (block b0010).

Tensile tests were carried out at room temperature at an initial strain rate of 5×10^-4 s^-1 in a Zwick ZH 100 machine; tensile samples were cylindrical with 6 mm gauge diameter and 40 mm length; interrupted tensile tests to different strain levels were used to study microstructural evolution with strain (block b0010).

Microstructures of the tensile-deformed steels were examined by electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) in a Zeiss Crossbeam (XB 1540) instrument and by TEM in a Phillips CM20 microscope; thin foils prepared by electropolishing in 30% nitric acid in methanol at -30 °C and 10 V (block b0010).

Precipitation states: the long annealed 2Al steel contains coarse intergranular M3C-type carbides (~1 µm wide × 3 µm long); the short annealed 8Al steel contains heterogeneous intragranular nanosized κ-carbides (2–5 nm, L'01 structure, cube/cube with austenite); the long annealed 8Al steel contains a uniform distribution of cuboidal κ-carbides (10 × 20 nm) forming matrix channels 2–3 nm wide (blocks b0025, b0031, b0033).

Mechanical properties (Table 1): 2Al 450 °C/1 h — YS 420 MPa, UTS 935 MPa, UE 75%; 2Al 650 °C/72 h — YS 400 MPa, UTS 850 MPa, UE 35%; 8Al 450 °C/1 h — YS 540 MPa, UTS 895 MPa, UE 65%; 8Al 600 °C/24 h — YS 990 MPa, UTS 1180 MPa, UE 37% (block b0022).
